name: Sorenona -And to End-
source:
School's rooftop has been closed for a long time. It's raining hard outdoors, only two people stay at school during this time. And the story comes to an end.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
